SELECT date_table.dates AS dateValue, ROUND(IFNULL( temp.total_weight, 0 ) ,2) AS ton FROM ( SELECT @s := @s + 1 AS indexs,
DATE_FORMAT( DATE( DATE_SUB( CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL @s YEAR ) ), #{dimension} ) AS dates
DATE_FORMAT( DATE( DATE_SUB( CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL @s MONTH ) ), #{dimension} ) AS dates
DATE_FORMAT( DATE( DATE_SUB( CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL @s DAY ) ), #{dimension} ) AS dates
FROM mysql.help_topic, ( SELECT @s := -1 ) temp WHERE @s < #{val} ORDER BY dates ) date_table LEFT JOIN ( select a.dateValue, sum( a.total_weight ) as total_weight from ( select DATE_FORMAT( a.create_time, #{dimension} ) AS dateValue, ifnull( ( a.quantity * b.net_weight ) / 1000, 0 ) as total_weight from mes_building_warehouse_record a left join tech_artifact b on b.bool_delete_enum = 0 and a.product_id = b.id where a.bool_delete_enum = 0 and a.product_type = 2 and a.type = #{type} ) a GROUP BY a.dateValue ) temp ON date_table.dates = temp.dateValue ORDER BY date_table.dates

select ifnull( sum( a.target_production ) / 1000, 0 ) as target_production from mes_building_production_line a where a.bool_delete_enum = 0 and a.product_type = 2 and a.bool_enabled_enum = 1 and a.production_line_type_enum = 1

select ifnull( sum(( a.quantity * b.net_weight ) / 1000), 0 ) as total_weight from mes_building_warehouse_summary a left join tech_artifact b on b.bool_delete_enum = 0 and a.product_id = b.id where a.bool_delete_enum = 0 and a.product_type = 2 and a.type = #{type} and date_format( a.create_time, #{dimension} ) = date_format( #{date}, #{dimension} )

SELECT date_table.dates AS dateValue, temp.id, temp.short_name as workShopShortName, temp.ton FROM ( SELECT @s := @s + 1 AS indexs,
DATE_FORMAT( DATE( DATE_SUB( CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL @s YEAR ) ), #{dimension} ) AS dates
DATE_FORMAT( DATE( DATE_SUB( CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL @s MONTH ) ), #{dimension} ) AS dates
DATE_FORMAT( DATE( DATE_SUB( CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL @s DAY ) ), #{dimension} ) AS dates
FROM mysql.help_topic, ( SELECT @s := - 1 ) temp WHERE @s < 0 ORDER BY dates ) date_table LEFT JOIN ( select a.id, a.short_name, round( ifnull( sum( ton ), 0 ), 2 ) as ton, a.dateValue from ( select a.id, CASE WHEN a.short_name is null THEN a.`name` WHEN a.short_name = '' THEN a.`name` ELSE a.`name` END AS short_name, ( b.quantity * c.net_weight ) / 1000 as ton, date_format( #{date}, #{dimension} ) as dateValue from mes_building_workshop a left join mes_building_complete b on a.id = b.workshop_id and b.bool_delete_enum = 0 and b.task_type_enum = 2 and date_format( b.create_time, #{dimension} ) = date_format( #{date}, #{dimension} ) left join tech_artifact c on c.id = b.product_id and c.bool_delete_enum = 0 where a.bool_delete_enum = 0 ) a group by a.id, a.dateValue ) temp ON date_table.dates = temp.dateValue ORDER BY date_table.dates

SELECT a.dateValue, b.id as workShopId, b.short_name as workShopShortName, b.ton FROM ( select concat( ( select year ( now( ) ) ), '-01' ) as dateValue union select concat( ( select year ( now( ) ) ), '-02' ) union select concat( ( select year ( now( ) ) ), '-03' ) union select concat( ( select year ( now( ) ) ), '-04' ) union select concat( ( select year ( now( ) ) ), '-05' ) union select concat( ( select year ( now( ) ) ), '-06' ) union select concat( ( select year ( now( ) ) ), '-07' ) union select concat( ( select year ( now( ) ) ), '-08' ) union select concat( ( select year ( now( ) ) ), '-09' ) union select concat( ( select year ( now( ) ) ), '-10' ) union select concat( ( select year ( now( ) ) ), '-11' ) union select concat( ( select year ( now( ) ) ), '-12' ) ) a left join ( select a.id, a.short_name, round( ifnull( sum( ton ), 0 ), 2 ) as ton, a.dateValue from ( select a.id, CASE WHEN a.short_name is null THEN a.`name` WHEN a.short_name = '' THEN a.`name` ELSE a.`name` END AS short_name, ( b.quantity * c.net_weight ) / 1000 as ton, date_format( b.create_time, '%Y-%m' ) as dateValue from mes_building_workshop a left join mes_building_complete b on a.id = b.workshop_id and b.bool_delete_enum = 0 and b.task_type_enum = 2 and date_format( b.create_time, '%Y' ) = date_format( '2023-03-03', '%Y' ) left join tech_artifact c on c.id = b.product_id and c.bool_delete_enum = 0 where a.bool_delete_enum = 0 and a.id = #{workShopId} ) a group by a.id, a.dateValue ) b on a.dateValue = b.dateValue order by a.dateValue asc, b.short_name
